summary: The Playwright artifact compiles and uses correct Playwright APIs, including awaiting asynchronous assertions. However, the selector appears to be a data-test attribute which is good, but the test lacks strong assertion coverage on page content beyond URL verification, reducing assertion strength and maintainability. The test case ID is not preserved in the test title. The code is simple and maintainable but could improve reusability by parameterizing baseURL and adding more assertions to confirm the category page content.

issues.description: The test title does not include the testCaseId 'TC-001' for traceability between the manual test case and the automated test.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to maintain traceability.

issues.description: The test only asserts URL change and does not verify presence or visibility of category page elements or product lists, weakening the test's ability to confirm that the category page is actually displayed.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions verifying key category page elements are visible to strengthen test validation.

issues.description: baseURL is hardcoded within the test file rather than being configurable or imported from a configuration, limiting reusability.
issues.recommendation: Externalize baseURL to a configuration or environment variable.

recommendations: Preserve testCaseId in the test title for better traceability.
Enhance assertions to verify key elements on the category page beyond URL change.
Parameterize baseURL to improve reusability and flexibility.
